direct-contract.representation: No mathematical law added; product clause directly supplies the contract.

store.representation: Concrete UTF-8 file bytes abstract to the same finite byte sequence. Body is an exact supplied substring; generated framing is separate. Successful span updates preserve prefix/suffix; missing/ambiguous targets have explicit no-write outcomes. Partial correctness does not promise successful I/O, termination, or durability.

identity.representation: File+heading describes a lookup key; abstraction maps it to zero/one/multiple source occurrences. No global uniqueness invariant for external files. Partial unique lookup yields missing, one occurrence or ambiguous error; writes require exactly one. Source ranges retain Unicode text offsets whose UTF-8 encoding observes outside byte equality.

calendar.representation: Carrier is supported Gregorian date, years 1..9999. Python date comparison/equality models le; filenames are rendered observations, not lexical order keys. Relative integer parsing may fail on overflow but cannot reject/change representation of an otherwise supported date. Previous/next return optional neighbor, not a synthetic sentinel date. format_diary_date renders fixed-width day/month/year explicitly, including year 0001; overflow remains an explicit error. format_diary_date renders fixed-width day/month/year explicitly, including year 0001; overflow remains an explicit error. format_diary_date renders fixed-width day/month/year explicitly, including year 0001; overflow remains an explicit error.

selection.representation: None = cancelled; every list, including [], = accepted payload. Case analysis chooses prior associations or the intended backend tag set. Equality of persisted tags is set equality over HTFS leaf identities; list/order/path spelling is not tag-set equality. Successful equations exclude failure effects, which PERSIST separately specifies.

editor.representation: State abstraction: busy=>working; original_draft!=None=>reviewing, with original as abstract draft and current buffer as displayed proposal; otherwise editing, with current buffer as draft. Submit closes. Constructor starts editing with no proposal. Only accepted proposal changes abstract draft; model errors/rejection retain it. Transitions include toolkit dispatch filters, not handlers in isolation. No fairness or eventual model completion assumed.

tasks.representation: Raw source snapshots and location observations are retained. PendingTask exposes due_status/priority_status as absent, validated or unvalidated while raw spellings remain unchanged. Completion validates every selected file before changes and records one batch intent before its first write; state characters alone change. Partial writes have truthful outcomes and metadata-only retry never replays task edits.

key-equivalence.representation: Normalize task text excluding due/priority, then compare exact normalized keys. class(a) is represented implicitly by the set of candidate/open-history texts sharing a key; there is no explicit public equivalence-class API. No transitive-class interpretation is assigned to lexical near-matching or model similarity. Completed history must not be an open-task carrier. Day-line comparison now retains the checkbox kind/state; completed history and ordinary notes cannot stand for an existing open task. Day-line comparison now retains the checkbox kind/state; completed history and ordinary notes cannot stand for an existing open task. Day-line comparison now retains the checkbox kind/state; completed history and ordinary notes cannot stand for an existing open task.

outcomes.representation: OperationJournal establishes durable operation identity/intent before mutation. FileIntent records prior/intended fingerprints and observed write states; TagIntent records resource existence, prior/intended/checkpoint/in-flight associations. DiaryPersistence writes/verifies content before metadata and verifies closed backend sessions via fresh observations. Errors expose complete/no-change failure/partial/uncertain/conflict, with operation IDs. Metadata-only retry checks content, unique identity and state; completed/resolved receipts never replay mutations. An uninspectable possible completion receipt is retained, never overwritten with a pending record. Taxonomy intent includes affected resources and expected node/edge progress.

config.representation: Constructor parses raw config into AppConfig(Path, Optional[str]); DiaryAgent normalizes blank model to None. Equality observes effective directory/model/backend origin, not dataclass field layout. File/prompt errors are operational failures; non-TTY must not prompt.

backend.representation: Pinned HTFS source and per-diary boundary own SQLite/RDF and hierarchy. Adapter owns clients and close. Initialization establishes usable boundary by preflight inventory read, not merely database-file existence. No atomicity across content and metadata or proof of backend correctness is imported. All operational mutations now use DiaryPersistence; initial boundary setup/preflight is separate. Resource deletion verifies absence, not just an empty tag list. All operational mutations now use DiaryPersistence; initial boundary setup/preflight is separate. Resource deletion verifies absence, not just an empty tag list. All operational mutations now use DiaryPersistence; initial boundary setup/preflight is separate. Resource deletion verifies absence, not just an empty tag list.

model.representation: Environment supplies optional nondeterministic response or failure. Configured model, explicit invocation, availability and accepted content are separate observations. Prompts constrain requested behavior; model facts, termination and every possible response are not guaranteed. Allowlist has five tasks only.

search.representation: Finite local result list of path/section/snippet/score/tag observations. Ordered score ranking is product-specific; equal-score tie order is unspecified. Tag restriction is set membership over unique section IDs; no match is an ordinary empty result. Search body has no content/tag mutation, while startup may initialize metadata by DEP-02.
